sampling_scope: Completed frozen development capture frame; positive original reward sources only. Held-out data unchanged. Not a task-wide population or a measurement of training degradation.
reference_scope: The original single-EOS actual target probability ratio; union of all matching recorded native-dtype/head sensitivity views. These are observed numerical ranges, not confidence bounds on an exact oracle.
confidence_scope: 95% finite-population sampling bounds, conditional on the recorded reference ranges; pointwise per task/threshold/state. No simultaneous claim across all groups. No model/numerical error coverage.
interpretation: Do not pool earlier diagnostic samples. TP/FP come from the same-frame predicted-tail census; FN/TN use the saved inclusion probabilities. Estimated FN totals are not numbers of observed positives. Magnitude unsupported does not mean its negative sign is unsupported.
